scope: Source-verified ONVIF lifecycle lineage and raw vendor-coordinate zone queries

mission.goal: Turn retained vendor metadata into exact source-linked lifecycle and zone observations without rewriting frozen source/tracklet generations or promoting them to physical or effect authority.

authority.git: User authorized frequent meaningful direct-main GitHub commits with no PRs; expected-head non-force updates preserve concurrent work.
authority.query: Existing pinned XML/RTP only; ordinary exclusive publisher opening/recovery may perform housekeeping. No missing deployment initialization or pending effect reconciliation.

published_checkpoints.change: Bounded additive lifecycle wire interpretation; unchanged events-v1 and analytics-v2.
Source-linked lineage and retained two-pass owner, complete document receipts, actual-source contracts and inner JSON renderer.
Native lifecycle command, bounded complete JSON/schema, process fixtures, restored formatting checks and usage documentation.

Exact raw vendor-zone policy/geometry, retained two-pass owner and zones command, complete matrices/transitions/JSON/schema, genuine process fixtures, and explicit child-module path fixes for all metadata query wrappers.

cases.question: Can vendor lifecycle declarations explain changes between existing runs without rewriting their identities?
cases.finding: Yes: ordered operations resolve only to exact current or immediately preceding eligible module-frame occurrences, with unresolved/conflicted states and explicit integer reuse. Normative self Merge/Split endpoints are supported.
cases.qualification: Actual production-source tests executed; no physical identity or truth of vendor claims asserted.

cases.question: Can empty, frozen or rejected sources disappear from query verification?
cases.finding: No: every source/document has an explicit disposition; both complete source and projection passes compare under one shared allowance, followed by final durable-head/effect-store checks.
cases.qualification: Fourteen genuine native tests authored and independently reviewed; native execution remains unestablished.

cases.question: Can complete vendor boxes yield useful zone observations while preserving unknown geometry?
cases.finding: Yes: exact decimal outward intervals and explicit pinned raw-coordinate rectangles produce complete inside/outside/boundary/unavailable matrices and original-occurrence endpoint transitions. Wrong or missing basis never counts as outside or physical absence.
cases.qualification: Twenty new pure actual-source contracts plus four embedded tests executed. Seven genuine native owner and three process tests authored/reviewed; process harness typechecked but native behavior not executed.

contracts.compatibility: Frozen source encodings and original tracks-v1 grouping/identities unchanged; additive interpretation has its own generation and domains. No dependency or lockfile edits.
contracts.privacy: Raw module/integer/time values null unless include-values yes; UUIDs never matched or emitted.
contracts.semantics: Idle/Removed are separate from Delete; repeated/competing/sequential declarations and integer reuse remain explicit. No physical identity, departure, coverage, absence, calibrated geometry, event or effect authority.
contracts.zone_semantics: Exact outward-rounded raw boxes with declared margins; four exact coordinate-domain pins; inside/outside/boundary/unavailable; complete matrices and original-tracklet endpoint transitions; no transform, calibration, interpolation, capture clock or dwell.
contracts.zone_policy_identity: Semantic ordered policy is separate from exact policy-file SHA/length. Operator annotations/coordinates are always reported; original vendor values remain opt-in.

budgets.work: Same cumulative source/history/parse/projector/receipt allowance across both passes; each lifecycle projection reserves the complete genuine tracklet replay allowance.
budgets.exclusions: Opening recovery and metadata/open syscalls remain outside indexed-source read counters under existing deployment limits; deterministic work units are not CPU time.
budgets.cancellation: Explicit ReplayCx/native request ownership, drain on success and refusal, final authority verification after last callback, serialization inside ordinary runtime::run.

validation.schema: Lifecycle JSON/closed-object/40-ref/source-shape review passed. Zone policy/report JSON/10-closed-object/33-ref checks and actual parser/renderer template comparison passed. No installed standard JSON Schema validator; formal schema validation unexecuted.
validation.independent_review: Separate reviewers checked lifecycle and zone pure contracts, exact decimal math, retained owners/shared budgets, native CLI wrappers, policy identities, schemas and real process fixtures. No remaining blocking source finding; native execution remains unestablished.
validation.infrastructure: Shared disk pressure and temporary environment loss were recovered; tested source bytes were preserved and read-back verified through GitHub. Execution is available again.
validation.qualification: No native integrated execution, physical-device/Profile M conformance or release qualification claimed.

process_harness_typechecks.onvif_metadata_tracks_cli: passed pinned rustc --test --emit=metadata with genuine fss-core; no CLI execution
process_harness_typechecks.onvif_metadata_zones_cli: passed pinned rustc --test --emit=metadata with genuine fss-core; no CLI execution

validation.module_resolution: Recursive pinned rustfmt checks passed for root metadata CLI and reference metadata. The checks exposed and fixed explicit child-path annotations in analysis, tracks/report, report/projection and zones/report; these are parse/module-resolution checks, not full native typechecking.

findings: Frozen tracks-v1 can coexist with an independent explainable lifecycle graph.
All source dispositions and strict ambiguity must remain visible; a successful empty report does not certify absence.
Source custody and derived semantics must share cumulative request limits and final authority checks.
Exact source-linked lifecycle and zone reports can share the same original tracklet digest and occurrence references while keeping their independent policies, unknowns and provenance explicit.

obligations.work: Execute genuine native owner, CLI parser and process suites on a host that can compile the unchanged dependency closure.
Complete broader FSS-046/FSS-077 device qualification, continuous capture and calibrated scene/event requirements.
Continuous metadata capture needs an explicit provisional-to-durable identity contract before streaming derived output can reuse finite-source handles.
Canonical agent/MCP integration needs a shared metadata read view that does not acquire writable publisher recovery; do not wrap the existing exclusive retained owner as a no-write query.
Physical scene geometry, calibration, class mapping and event/effect integration require their separately qualified owners; raw vendor zones grant none of them.

unknowns: Passing pure production-source contracts does not establish native owner or CLI execution.
Vendor lifecycle references do not establish physical identity or exact movement.
Raw-coordinate rectangles do not establish a pixel/image/world basis or physical occupancy. Unknown lifecycle and coordinate material remains explicit under each frozen interpretation.
invalidations: Any source/root/deletion/authority mismatch, changed replay, exhausted shared limit or cancellation refuses the entire query.
A historical source snapshot grants no current effect permission.
Broad beads remain open pending their complete registered evidence.
